name: Branched Menu
description: Vertical collapsible menu with a trunk line and curved branch connectors to child rows. Selecting a child draws an accent line along its branch while a marker glides to the section heading.
contents: Vertical nav with section headings that fold open and closed
SVG trunk and rounded branch lines to each child row, with optional icons
Accent path that draws to the active child and a sliding marker on the left rail
behavior: Clicking a heading with children toggles its section with an animated grid-row fold
Clicking a child sets it active, draws the accent branch and highlights the row
Items without children act as direct selectable leaves
Marker slides to the active section heading and hides when that section is collapsed
Marker repositions without animation on resize
Collapsed child buttons are removed from tab order
Reduced motion preference disables fold, draw and marker slide transitions

props.name: items
props.default: 2 sample sections (Getting started, Components) with 4 children each

editableByProps: Menu items, labels, values, icons and nesting
Initially open sections and initially active child
Width, row height, indent, trunk position, corner radius, line width and font size

needsCodeEdit.change: Allow only one open section at a time
Change the easing of the fold or marker glide
needsCodeEdit.where: grid-template-rows transition class on the fold wrapper and the markerRef span

needsCodeEdit.change: Change heading size relative to children
needsCodeEdit.where: font-size calc(var(--bm-font)+1px) class on the section heading button

needsCodeEdit.change: Add more than one nesting level

fixed: Requires @hugeicons/react and @hugeicons/core-free-icons for the default icons
Needs Tailwind CSS with arbitrary value and group-data variants
Only one level of nesting is supported
Children need unique value strings, used as keys and active identifiers
Uses a ResizeObserver on the nav to reposition the marker
Text color inherits font family from the parent and muted color is 55% of color
Left rail is a fixed 2px gradient fading to transparent
Marker height is fixed at 16px and the body padding at 6px
